# Artifact Gateway v0.7.0

## 简体中文

本次新增正式离线 `gateway snapshot-import verify|dry-run|apply`，保留准入的全部 SNAPSHOT timestamp/build、extension/classifier、完整主资产与原始版本 metadata，以及源选定的当前解析（可以指向旧 build）。导入按固定 manifest 和完整字节验证，严格拒绝缺文件、POM/path/metadata 不一致与目标冲突；异常需人工明确整 GAV 排除，不自动修复。绑定目标身份与容量计划，GAV 原子 checkpoint 支持幂等重试、部分失败恢复、GC 防护与可审计结果。包含官方 `maven-archetype` packaging 的 JAR 支持。

历史验收后可显式 `takeover --idempotency-key`（支持 `--dry-run`）。接管只记授权与审计，不改历史或当前解析；后续普通 Maven timestamped 发布按客户端收据隔离，完整就绪才推进 current，保留固定历史和未更新 classifier 的源选择。保护模式默认拒绝普通发布；接管后拒绝重新导入及会破坏保护历史的 retention 启用。真实 Maven 的中断、重试、冷解析和迟到 metadata 纳入强制门禁。

另将 Console 间接依赖 source-map-js 更新至 1.2.2，修复 GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q；依赖审计没有新增例外。API 契约版本同步为 0.7.0，已有接口行为不因版本同步改变。

### 从 v0.6.1 升级

v0.6.1 的 migration ledger 为 140 项；v0.7.0 增加 `000141` 导入 checkpoint 与 `000142` 发布接管，共 142 项，既有 SQL 不改写。先按[恢复手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.7.0/docs/recovery-runbook.zh-CN.md)完成完整写入者范围的已验证 PostgreSQL/S3 配对备份，独立保管配置与加密 key。通过既有迁移流程依次应用迁移，并让所有连接同一目标的 Gateway API、reader、scheduler、worker 使用本次同一 revision；Console 使用匹配的 0.7.0 资产。schema 添加不足以支持混跑：旧二进制不能连接扩展后的数据库，不能尝试 down migration；回退依赖升级前配对快照与匹配的旧软件。

升级交接与产品发布不代表生产已部署或真实迁移已验收。后续先建立审阅后的 Repository 映射，保持 retention 停用，冻结完整源清单并核验全部字节，再按[导入操作手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.7.0/docs/maven-snapshot-import.zh-CN.md)进行隔离演练、verify、容量预检、dry-run、apply 与只读客户端验收；验收后才决定是否显式接管。旧式缺 `snapshotVersions` 的 metadata 不受 v1 支持，源 checksum 文本空白/大小写不宣称原样保留。只读依赖闭包与通用迁移 ledger 仍由 #204/#205 独立跟踪。

## English

This release adds the offline `gateway snapshot-import verify|dry-run|apply` operator path. It preserves every admitted SNAPSHOT timestamp/build, extension/classifier, complete primary byte stream, raw version metadata and source-selected current resolution, including older builds. A pinned manifest and complete-byte checks reject missing files, inconsistent POM/path/metadata and target conflicts. Anomalies require explicit whole-GAV exclusion without repair. Target/capacity binding, atomic per-GAV checkpoints, idempotent replay, partial-failure recovery, GC protection and audit evidence are included, with official `maven-archetype` JAR packaging support.

After historical acceptance, explicit `takeover --idempotency-key` supports dry-run and records authorization/audit without changing history or current resolution. Subsequent ordinary timestamped Maven deployments use receipt isolation and advance current only when complete, preserving immutable history and unchanged source classifier selections. Protected imports reject ordinary publication by default; takeover seals re-import and blocks retention enablement that could remove protected history. Mandatory real Maven gates cover interruption, retry, cold resolution and delayed metadata.

Console's transitive source-map-js is updated to 1.2.2 for GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q without an audit exception. API contract versions become 0.7.0 without changing existing endpoint behavior.

### Upgrade from v0.6.1

The migration ledger grows from 140 to 142 entries: `000141` adds import checkpoints and `000142` adds publication takeover. Existing migration SQL remains unchanged. Follow the [recovery runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.7.0/docs/recovery-runbook.md) for a validated PostgreSQL/S3 backup across the complete writer scope, keeping configuration and encryption keys separate. Apply migrations in order through the existing workflow and use this same revision for every connected Gateway API, reader, scheduler and worker; use matching 0.7.0 Console assets. Schema addition does not make mixed revisions safe. Do not connect old binaries to the expanded database or attempt down migrations; rollback requires the paired pre-upgrade snapshot and matching old software.

Product publication and upgrade handoff do not establish production deployment or real migration acceptance. Review Repository mapping, keep retention disabled, freeze a complete source inventory and verify every byte before isolated rehearsal, verify, capacity preflight, dry-run, apply and read-only client acceptance in the [operator runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.7.0/docs/maven-snapshot-import.md). Decide on explicit takeover only after acceptance. v1 does not support legacy metadata without `snapshotVersions` and does not preserve source checksum text whitespace/case. Dependency closure and the general migration ledger remain separately tracked in #204/#205.
